description: The AD-to-M365 onboarding seed writes each of its four template mappings as an explicit tenant-source variant with a tenant status ID and null standard and unresolved IDs.
A newly created tenant can run onboarding seeds 06 and 07 in order against the PR 3135 typed schema and receive exactly four AD-to-M365 status mappings.
Every seeded AD-to-M365 mapping references a project-task status owned by the same tenant, even when another tenant has matching status names.
The seeded AD-to-M365 template passes production runtime status resolution and, when practical, can be applied with usable tenant-backed project status mappings.
